schema_note: Each entry follows docs/mvp/templates/skill-authoring/trigger-queries.json (id, query, should_trigger, split) plus a category field, matching the Claude devforge-brainstorm convention. Tier A only: these observe whether the terminal consults the skill for a request that does not name it. No entry supplies the skill path or name except the explicit_invocation category, which is recorded separately and is never counted as implicit activation evidence.
split_policy: Fixed and stratified by should_trigger and category, assigned once at authoring time and recorded here. It is not re-randomized per run. Validation entries and their should_trigger values must not be placed in an author-loop or task-worker context; only the train split may drive any description iteration.
negative_note: The negatives are the near misses the specification and roster actually name. Four route to a sibling skill (develop, design, change, brainstorm); two should route nowhere, because an uncertainty that inspection settles needs no experiment and an unrelated use of the word 'prototype' is not this skill's domain. A negative passes only on a completed run with no consultation of this skill; an incomplete run is COULD_NOT_RUN.
